description:
Report whether a design is ready to attach and whether it was
locked in the editor.

`attachable=true` means RendReal has saved a version of the design, so the
customer can go to checkout NOW. That holds for a
resolved design (a `design_chat` turn with `design_resolved=true`) once
RendReal saves it, which takes seconds for most products and a few minutes
for a photo book. Until then `attachable=false` with `thumbnails_pending=true`:
poll again. It also holds for a design saved in the editor. Do NOT wait for
`completed`.

`completed=true` is the narrower signal that the user saved/finished the
design in the editor (after which `design_chat` is refused). It is set by
this tool's own 360 editor-save poll; if the poll has not observed the
save yet the design can still be attachable, so gate checkout on
`attachable`, never on `completed`. When present,
`design_url` + `thumbnails` are AUTHORITATIVE — share `design_url` as a
markdown hyperlink and show the thumbnails; never invent or guess a URL.
name: design_status

anyOf.description:
Whether a design was completed in the editor (via the 360 editor-save
poll) and whether it can be attached to an order right now.

items.description: One position's rendered thumbnail from Artifex's getDesign response.

thumbnails_pending.description: `true` when the images are still rendering. They may not become available, so do not say that the preview will appear.

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: Get design status
